title: HAL tests: Add duty cycle init boundary tests for permille=0 and permille>1000
description: lichen_duty_cycle_init clamps invalid permille values (0 or >1000) to the default of 10. These boundary conditions are untested. Add tests verifying the clamping behavior.
close_reason: Added test_duty_cycle_init_clamps_invalid_permille test to verify clamping behavior for permille=0, permille>1000, and UINT16_MAX; also verifies boundary values permille=1 and permille=1000 are accepted.
